title: 第6章 分手神曲《体面》-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “写歌？还有这个技能呢你？”

    因为过于惊讶，沈阳人的本能倒装句都出来了。

    秦兰知道对方唱歌不错，但是唱和写，完全是两码事。

    “我就是最近有点灵感，随便写写。”

    “你唱给我听听。”

    魏沐点点头，清了清嗓子，把秦兰当成王小晨，投入感情的唱起来。

    《体面》这首歌在当年的互联网上有多火不必多说。

    就说一句，《前任3》这部烂剧，能有这么高的票房，多亏了这首歌的影响力。

    正印证了那句话，自古烂片出神曲。

    除此之外还有一个《说散就散》，他打算留着，放在后面用。

    魏沐以前直播的时候唱过很多次，对这首歌了如指掌。

    而且原主的嗓音条件不错。

    当然了，这些都是技巧层面。

    想要真正打动人心，必须带着感情唱歌。

    魏沐刚经历了一段分手，说没有一点难受是假的。

    所以，他用了方法派的演绎手法，把面前的秦兰当成了王小晨。

    上辈子作为视频博主，他看过很多火爆全网的作品，其中就有一个男子分手后唱歌的画面。

    没有技巧，全是感情。

    但就这样引起了全网共鸣，超5万人在下面留言。

    “别堆砌怀念让剧情变得狗血.....来不及再轰轰烈烈，就保留告别的尊严.....分手应该体面...谁都不要说抱歉....何来亏欠......”

    悲伤的旋律穿越时间和空间，犹如曾经深爱的人在耳边呢喃。

    一曲结束，秦兰怔住了。

    看着魏沐的眼神，她心里突然咯噔一下，别样的情感像暖流一般缓缓流出。

    不过作为专业演员，她很快反应过来，直接问道：“你和晓晨分手了？”

    “嗯。”

    “为......”

    说到这里，秦兰把后面的话咽进去，没有继续问。

    弟弟刚才的眼神这么难过，一看就不是正常分手。

    这个时候问他，不是往人家心口戳刀子吗？

    “姐...姐.....”

    魏沐在秦岚面前晃了晃手，后者顿了几秒，轻声安慰：“你也不要难过，我们这个圈子分分合合很正常，我以前就跟你说过尽量不要找圈内人，容易分手。”

    你可拉倒吧，你还一本正经教育起我来了？

    “不过话又说回来。你这首歌写的真不错。”

    秦兰唱歌一般，是在KTV吼两嗓子的水平。

    其实她嗓音不错，听起来很甜，后世“电音朵拉”也是在她声带受损之后的调侃。

    2018年，其为《延禧攻略》演唱的片尾曲《雪落下的声音》，便受到广大网友一致好评。

Page (1/3)

"Writing songs? Do you still have this skill?"

Because she was so surprised, Shenyang people’s instinct was to use inverted sentences.

Qin Lan knew that the other party was good at singing, but singing and writing were completely different things.

"I just have some inspiration recently, so I just write about it."

"Sing it to me."

Wei Mu nodded, cleared his throat, and began to sing emotionally, thinking that Qin Lan was Wang Xiaochen.

It goes without saying how popular the song "Decent" was on the Internet back then.

Let me just say that the bad drama "Exes 3" has such a high box office, thanks to the influence of this song.

It just proves that saying, bad movies have always been a great comedy.

In addition, there is also a piece of "Let's break up", which he plans to keep for later use.

Wei Mu has sung it many times during live broadcasts before and knows the song well.

And the original owner’s voice is in good condition.

Of course, these are all technical aspects.

If you want to truly touch people's hearts, you must sing with emotion.

Wei Mugang just went through a breakup, and it would be a lie to say that he didn’t feel any discomfort at all.

Therefore, he used Methodist deduction techniques to think that Qin Lan in front of him was Wang Xiaochen.

As a video blogger in his previous life, he had seen many works that became popular on the Internet, including a scene of a man singing after a breakup.

There are no skills, it’s all about emotion.

But it resonated with the entire Internet, and more than 50,000 people left messages below.

"Don't pile up nostalgia and make the plot bloody... If you don't have time to make it more exciting, just keep the dignity of saying goodbye... Breaking up should be dignified... No one should say sorry... Why owe anything..."

The sad melody travels through time and space, like someone you once loved whispering in your ears.

After the song ended, Qin Lan was stunned.

Looking at Wei Mu's eyes, her heart suddenly skipped a beat, and a different kind of emotion slowly flowed out like a warm current.

But as a professional actor, she quickly reacted and asked directly: "Did you break up with Xiaochen?"

"Yeah."

"For..."

Having said this, Qin Lan swallowed the rest of the words and did not continue to ask.

The look in my brother’s eyes just now was so sad, it seemed like this was not a normal breakup.

Asking him at this time, isn’t it like stabbing someone in the heart?

"Sister...sister..."

Wei Mu waved his hand in front of Qin Lan, who paused for a few seconds and comforted softly: "Don't be sad, it's normal for our circle to break up. I've told you before that you should try not to find people in the circle, as it's easy to break up."

​​​​​ ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ together. Are you still educating me seriously?

"But then again. You wrote this song really well."

Qin Lan’s singing is average, at the level of shouting at a KTV.

In fact, she has a good voice and sounds very sweet. Later generations of "Electronic Dora" were also ridiculed after her vocal cords were damaged.

In 2018, the ending song "The Sound of Falling Snow" sung for "Story of Yanxi Palace" was well received by netizens.
